head: 76ed7334
non_blocking_findings: Timing assertion has modest headroom: one reading synchronous 19.46 ms vs pipelined 3.66 ms (ratio 0.19 vs 0.25 limit) at load ~5; on a loaded host it could flake (not seen in 12+ runs here, load 3-11).

Mutants M1 (reset after SimBridge.new) and M2b (reset only in the pipelined run) survive: they are equivalent (the first run starts from a fresh process counter and no CrewConsole is built in between). The reset is only load-bearing in the second run, as designed.

The sent journal does not record the heartbeat dt: a 1% dt divergence in one pipelined tick is caught only by 'same world at the end', and a 1e-9 relative divergence is below the world's resolution and survives (M8). The pipelined-vs-sync check has that sensitivity floor.
Fragile coupling: the test writes the private CrewConsole._serial; if production renames or scopes it the test hits a SCRIPT ERROR (the gate would refuse, so loud not silent).
Design doc has 13 mentions of 'ship-demo-ci: sim-pipeline-test' (prose about the deferred row 7ab); no code/Makefile line contains it.
